author: GamingBolt
description:
So you've played – or tried to play – all the major releases from September, and barely managed (or worse, added them to your backlog that you're totally going to clear any day now). Well, good news – October is equally packed, and probably has even more big titles to look forward to.

It would be one thing if only big-name sequels and blockbusters with budgets in the hundreds of millions were released. But October has even more to offer, including games that have seen decade-plus development journeys. That doesn't even include the major expansions, whether they're reviving their fanbases and delivering what they've always wanted, or charting new paths into the unknown.
title: 15 NEW Games of October 2026 You Need to Keep an Eye On

author: GamingBolt
description:
Star Wars: Galactic Racer is an excellent game. It boasts tight, thrilling, action packed racing that not only captures the Star Wars racing vibe perfectly, but also delivers an experience that comes absurdly close to the highs of the Burnout franchise. 

Meanwhile, the roguelite structure lends itself perfectly to the campaign, making for an immensely addictive and replayable experience. Though the game could do with a little more variety in the content on offer here and there, by and large, this is one of the most enjoyable Star Wars games in recent years, and absolutely unmissable for all fans of arcade racers.
title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
No-one plays Call of Duty for the story, right? Well, that’s true, with Modern Warfare 4’s campaign set to deliver the bombastic set pieces, globe-trotting action, and gritty character drama the genre has become known for. 

However, there is plenty more going on behind the explosions, with a contemporary setting hosting first-time soldiers, plus renewed authenticity and the return of Captain Price. Here are fifteen things you need to know about Modern Warfare 4’s single-player campaign before buying.
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Campaign (2026) - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
